title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Reveals Domina Blowelive Teaser Visual
content: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 TV anime revealed a new teaser visual ahead of its previously confirmed 2027 premiere. The anime was first announced as a sequel project , with the format confirmed to be a TV anime at last year’s Jump Festa . The new visual features Domina Blowelive, and you can check it out below.
author: Anime Corner

title: New Ghost in the Shell TV Anime by Science SARU Reveals Third Trailer & Key Visual, July 7 Premiere
content: The new THE GHOST IN THE SHELL TV anime by Science SARU revealed the third teaser trailer and new key visual. The anime was previously confirmed for July 2026, with July 7 confirmed as the premiere date today.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Modern Shonen Anime Series Just Landed a Massive Win Ahead of the Anime Awards
content: Crunchyroll featured the debut of a shonen anime last year that broke the mold of the genre and emerged as one of the most modern shonen series in recent years. The anime shattered expectations by focusing on a protagonist driven by revenge, something rarely explored in the genre.
author: ComicBook

title: Devil May Cry: How Netflix’s Second Season Finale Sets Up Season 3
content: Dante and Vergil have returned to Netflix, with Capcom’s beloved franchise, Devil May Cry , returning for its second season. When last we left the red-coat-wearing demon slayer, he had been captured by the organization known as DarkCom and dragged into the demon-filled universe known as Makai.
author: ComicBook

title: Prime Video’s Henry Cavill Starring Live-Action Anime Reboot Reveals Surprising Update
content: Henry Cavill is leading the cast of a new live-action anime movie for Amazon MGM Studios, and it got a surprising update as the reboot of the 1980s classic gets closer to its release.

title: Osamu Tezuka's Autobiographical War Manga, Postwar Life Get Live-Action TV Special
content: The official website for manga pioneer Osamu Tezuka announced on Saturday that NHK is producing a live-action television special based on the creator's autobiographical manga short "Paper Fortress" ("Kami no Toride").
author: ANN

title: Julius Fights Reid in Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 6 Preview
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 6 (Episode 72 overall) preview ahead of its May 11, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season . Studio WHITE FOX is animating.
author: Anime Corner

title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class Anime Reveals New Trailer
content: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class anime revealed a new trailer on Tuesday. The series is currently ongoing and has five episodes and ranked 6th at the Spring 2026 Week 5 rankings . It is available to stream on Crunchyroll. Studio CONNECT is animating with Hideki Tachibana as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess' Light Anime Gets 2nd Season in October
content: Animation ID announced on Tuesday that the light anime adaptation of SORAJIMA and Aminohada 's With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess ( Kizu Darake Seijo Yori Hōfuku wo Komete ) vertical-scrolling webtoon is premiering a second season in October.
author: ANN
